notes:
Need to search first.I wasn't able to write these notes, because I didn't read any sources.

On my first attempt, the pages I tried to open were blocked: the tool only opens addresses that have already come up in a search, and I hadn't searched yet. When I then ran a batch of ten searches together, I went over the tool's usage limit. After that it allowed no more searches or page reads at all. I never got any search results or page text.

Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say and never fill gaps from my own knowledge. So I haven't written anything for vv. 21–41, rather than give you notes with no sources behind them.

**When you run this again**, I'll search first and read the pages one or two at a time so I stay under the limit. The order I'd follow:
1. **Verse-by-verse sources:** the Enduring Word commentary on Numbers 22, the Bible Hub commentary pages for verses 22, 28, 32, 35 and 41 (Gill, Ellicott, Pulpit and others), the Precept Austin page for Numbers 22, and the NET Bible notes.
2. **Points of real disagreement:**
   - why God was angry in v. 22 after allowing the trip in v. 20 (Got Questions, Ligonier, Gill)
   - who the angel of the LORD is: an appearance of Christ before his birth, or a created angel
   - how to read the talking donkey in v. 28: as literal, as a vision, or as modern scholars see it (Bible Odyssey, NET notes)
3. **Other views:** Catholic and Orthodox comment on Balaam, for example in the Catholic Encyclopedia on New Advent or on Catholic.com. I'd also look for popular modern teaching that uses "the way of Balaam" (2 Peter 2:15) against prosperity preaching, and include it only if the allowed sites actually discuss it.

Just say "continue" and I'll start with the Enduring Word and Bible Hub pages.
